comments.author: Marco Reyes
comments.body: Product wants the tile on the Billing overview dashboard only, not the global home. Adjusting placement before implementation.

content.text: Product wants the tile on the Billing overview dashboard only, not the global home. Adjusting placement before implementation.
Billing leads lack a at-a-glance signal for disputes stuck open longer than a week. They currently filter the disputes table manually.

Add a manager dashboard tile "Open billing disputes > 7 days" showing count and a drill-down list sorted by age. Data source: disputes where status IN (open, needs_info) and opened_at < now() - interval 7 days. Acceptance: tile matches a manual SQL count on staging for tenant tnt_dash_demo, refreshes at most every 5 minutes, and respects the viewer's workspace scope.
